sections.installation:
Install from within wordpress

  • Visit the plugins page within your dashboard and select Add New.
  • Search for THRON.
  • Select THRON from the list.
  • Activate it from your Plugins page.
  • Go to Setting up below.

Install THRON plugin manually

  1. Upload thron.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Extract files
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Place <?php do_action('plugin_name_hook'); ?> in your templates

Setting up

  • Once the plugin is activated, go to the THRON settings.
  • You’ll be prompted to your THRON clientId, AppId and AppKey that you can find on the WordPress Connector page in THRON.
  • After saving, the plugin is active and connected to the THRON platform.

sections.description:
THRON is the Italian AI-SaaS that centralizes product and content operations in a unified platform, cutting costs and saving time.

THRON Connector for WordPress

Seamlessly connect your THRON Platform to WordPress and accelerate your publishing workflow. The THRON Connector enables editors to manage and deliver content directly from within the CMS—with no copies, no duplications, and always up-to-date.

Access your centralized Digital Asset Library of approved assets and publish them instantly using either THRON Universal Player or Gutenberg blocks.

Now fully compatible with ACF and supporting the latest Delivery APIs.

Features

  • Supports any content type: images, videos, audio files, documents, and more
  • Real-time updates: every change made in THRON is immediately reflected on your website, without manual interventions
  • Web-optimized images: use THRON AI MediaBoost to adapt content on the fly without duplicating assets
  • Advanced cropping options directly in the plugin: Automatic, Centered, Product, or Manual modes
  • Fine-tune image parameters like quality, brightness, contrast, sharpness, and saturation—no post-production required
  • Performance-first architecture: THRON Universal Player ensures lightning-fast loading and SEO-optimized delivery with adaptive streaming and lazy loading
  • 100% compatible with Gutenberg and ACF

Benefits

  • Eliminate redundant copies and duplications
  • Cut integration and maintenance costs
  • Maximize performance at scale, even during peak loads
  • Gain actionable insights with THRON Content Analytics

Requirements

The THRON Connector for WordPress is free. If you’re already using THRON Platform, contact your Success Manager or reach out at marketplace@thron.com for installation support.

Would you like to request a demo of THRON Platform? Click here.
